issues: Hydration warning in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Caused by the emergent visual-editor instrumentation wrapping option children in <span>. Not blocking, but pollutes the console with React hydration errors on every render of a select. Consider suppressing the dev-only x-* wrappers around <option> children.

action_items: Investigate console hydration warning (<span> inside <option>) caused by emergent visual-editor wrapping. Low priority - dev-only noise.
No functional fixes required - all Phase 2 features working end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1148 lines - consider splitting into modules (auth, chat, mock_exam, study_plan, leaderboard, referral) for maintainability per >700-line guideline.

Mock exam generate (server.py:909) and study-plan create (server.py:982) call openai_client without try/except; if GPT-4o returns malformed JSON or times out, request will 500 instead of a clean 502/503. Recommend wrapping in try/except and returning a friendly error.
POST /api/referral/apply uses `body: dict` instead of a Pydantic model - inconsistent with rest of codebase and skips validation. Define a `ReferralApplyRequest(BaseModel)` with `code: str`.
MockExamPage.jsx select dropdowns rely on default browser `<select>` rather than shadcn Select component — inconsistent with the rest of the app's design system.
test_credentials: Used dynamically registered TEST_phase2_*@neuralearn.ai accounts via /api/auth/register. Admin: admin@neuralearn.ai / Admin@123456 also available.
seed_data_creation: Created ~3 disposable TEST_* student accounts during backend pytest run. They remain in DB but are prefixed TEST_ for easy cleanup. One referral application persisted between two of them.

Run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_phase2.py -v. Note: mock-exam-generate and study-plan-create call GPT-4o so each test takes 10-40s; full suite runs in ~21s. Frontend Playwright test for Mock Exam class dropdown should add `await page.wait_for_function("document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=mock-class-select] option').length > 1")` before reading options — useEffect fetch needs ~500ms to populate the list.
